items.title: Prologis (PLD) Forms Joint Venture To Redevelop Former Joliet Casino Site
items.summary: Prologis (NYSE:PLD) has formed a joint venture with Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. to redevelop the former Hollywood Casino Joliet site. The partners plan to turn the Illinois property into a large-scale warehouse and distribution park aimed at modern logistics users. The project marks Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc.'s first move into the industrial and logistics real estate sector.
